Subject: Post-demo: proposed trial blueprint & success metrics (Verdant Health)

Hi Tom / Priya — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap + a proposed 6-week trial blueprint so we can lock scope and owners. I captured what we discussed on the call and suggested a minimal POC that validates the two core outcomes you prioritized.

Summary of demo call (short):
- Use case: Clinical documentation summarization + discharge note enrichment for a 5-provider pilot.
- Success metrics you asked for:
  • 30% reduction in average documentation time per encounter (target baseline: 10m -> target 7m)
  • >= 85% QA pass rate on clinical accuracy for discharge summaries (sampled)
- Technical constraints: on-prem data routing through Verdant VPC; audit logs retained 90 days; SOC2 evidence required.

Proposed 6-week trial blueprint (high level):
Week 0 (prep, sign): finalize SOW & access; Red team review (security)
Week 1 (ingest & baseline): ingest 2 weeks of de-identified encounters; run baseline token/latency profile
Weeks 2-3 (model tuning + integration): deploy private agent in Verdant staging; iterate prompt templates; run daily sampling
Week 4 (pilot run): run 5-provider pilot; capture time-on-doc and QA samples
Week 5 (analysis): compute metrics vs baseline; run QC review with Verdant clinicians
Week 6 (wrap + decision): present results; recommend rollout path or next steps

Owners & points of contact:
- Redwood: Aisha (Eng/PM lead) — access, checkpoints, result deck
- Redwood: Marissa (Customer Success) — adoption, QA sampling cadence
- Verdant: Tom Alvarez — clinical sponsor / pilot coordination
- Verdant: Priya Das — security & procurement contact

Risk & mitigations (short):
- Data access delays — mitigate by starting with de-identified sample set; parallelize onboarding tasks
- Accuracy concerns — predefine QA rubric and acceptance gates (we suggest 85% pass on 200 samples)

Attachments: POC charter draft + demo recording.

Next concrete asks (from Redwood to Verdant):
1) Confirm pilot cohort (names or roles) and target start week window (we proposed next week start if SOW signed)
2) Confirm who will provision staging credentials and preferred encryption/KMS flow
3) Any procurement terms we should be aware of (PO, contract reviewer names)

If that looks reasonable I’ll issue a draft SOW and DocuSign for signature, and Marissa and I will book a 30-min kickoff for Monday.

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
